steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the case.
Verify that both real bidding vendors are present in the comparison grid.
Verify Vendor A's offered quantity for the available line.
Verify Vendor A's rate on the available line.
Verify Vendor B's rate on the available line.
Verify the available line's amount arithmetic for Vendor A.
Verify the available line's amount arithmetic for Vendor B.
Verify that the lower bid ranks ahead of the higher bid.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the available line's full requested quantity to Vendor B.
Assert the observable partial allocation and its proposal value on the one-line prepared event.
